name: Loupe
description: A round magnifying glass that follows the pointer over whatever it wraps.

props.name: children
props.description: The content to magnify, usually an image. It is drawn a second time inside the glass, hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: zoom
props.description: How much larger the content appears inside the glass.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the glass, in pixels.

props.name: static
props.description: Pin the glass in place and ignore the pointer.

props.name: position
props.description: Where a static glass sits, in pixels from the top left. Defaults to the centre.

props.name: hovering
props.description: Show or hide the glass yourself (controlled).

props.name: onHoveringChange
props.description: Called when the pointer enters or leaves, or a finger touches down or lifts.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the wrapper, which clips the glass to its box; give it the same radius as the content. Unless the glass is static, a finger on the area moves the glass rather than scrolling the page. Also accepts every other prop of a div.

props.name: eager
props.description: Keeps the magnified copy mounted and painted once the lens scrolls near the screen, so the first hover is instant. Turn it off when the content is heavy (video, canvas) and a second copy would cost more than a moment's delay.
